# DIE ZEIT

> > DIE ZEIT's historical archive from 1946, documenting postwar Germany's political reconstruction, occupation zones, and international peace negotiations.

This collection represents DIE ZEIT's earliest issues from 1946, capturing the immediate postwar period in Germany under Allied occupation. The articles chronicle the Paris Peace Conference, economic reconstruction, cultural renewal, and the challenges of rebuilding German society across French, British, American, and Soviet zones.

## Key Topics

- Nachkriegszeit (Postwar Period)
- Besatzungszonen (Occupation Zones)
- 1946 Paris Peace Conference
- Postwar Germany Reconstruction
- French Occupation (Baden-Baden)
- British Zone Administration
- International Politics 1946
- Economic Recovery
- Political Education
- Cultural Renewal
- UNRRA Relief Operations
- German Industry Seizures
- Catholic Political Movements
- Housing Crisis
- Agricultural Challenges

## International Politics & Peace Conference

- [Friedenskonferenz](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/friedenskonferenz): 21 nations meet in Paris for postwar peace conference negotiations
- [WOCHENÜBERSICHT](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/wochenuebersicht): Weekly overview of 1946 Paris Peace Conference led by Bidault
- [Über unsere Kraft](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/ueber-unsere-kraft): London talks on British occupation zone food crisis in Germany
- [Politischer Katholizismus](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/politischer-katholizismus): Catholic parties rise in Western Europe: MRP, Christian Democrats

## Occupation Zones & Allied Administration

- [Frankreich in Baden-Baden](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/frankreich-in-baden-baden): French military government in Baden-Baden, postwar occupation zone
- [Beschlagnahmte Industrie](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/beschlagnahmte-industrie): Russian seizure of German assets in Eastern Austria including oil firms
- [Verwaltung und öffentliche Meinung](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/verwaltung-und-oeffentliche-meinung): Public administration and public opinion relationship examined

## Political & Cultural Reconstruction

- [Einheit des Geistes](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/einheit-des-geistes): Reinhold Schneider on spiritual renewal in postwar Germany
- [Erziehung zur Politik](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/erziehung-zur-politik): Fritz Schotthöfer on Germans' political education and culture
- [Masse und Elite](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/masse-und-elite): Regina Bohne on housing crisis and intellectual life in British zone
- [Kennzeichen der Moderne](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/kennzeichen-der-moderne): Modern art movements: Futurism, Cubism, Expressionism analyzed

## Economic Recovery & Industry

- [Die letzte Börsenwoche](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/die-letzte-boersenwoche): German stock market report covering banks like Commerzbank, Dresdner
- [Kurze Wirtschaftsmeldungen](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/kurze-wirtschaftsmeldungen): Brief economic news: UNRRA ending, reparations, wage increases
- [Gablonz im Umzug](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/gablonz-im-umzug): Gablonz bijouterie industry relocates from Bohemia to Bavaria
- [OPA weiter in Aktion](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/opa-weiter-in-aktion): Truman's Office of Price Administration continues US price controls
- [Fachschau des Wiederaufbaus](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/fachschau-des-wiederaufbaus): Arnsberg reconstruction exhibition shows postwar rebuilding solutions

## Optional

- [Ein Menschenfeind](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/ein-menschenfeind): 1872 story of Herr von Ségur's move from Paris to Saumur post-war
- [Das Bild der Amerikanerin](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/das-bild-der-amerikanerin): Review of Betty Smith's 'A Tree Grows In Brooklyn' and American women
- [Aushilfen in der Düngung](https://www.zeit.de/1946/24/aufhilfen-in-der-duengung): Hamburg Vierlande vegetable farming and fertilizer shortages
